title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be Hard on Yourself and Easy on Everyone Else
caption:
A godly man judges no one harder than himself. And nobody softer than the guy across the table.

Most men flip it. Sharp with everyone else's failures, soft on their own. Scripture flips it back.

Why do you look at the speck in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own? (Matthew 7:3). Pull yours out first. Then you can see clearly enough to help him with his.

Hold the standard for yourself. Hold the grace for him. Never trade the two.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #discipleship #brotherhood
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
